The '''Galsol system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galsol]].
